artists.name: Asterion
artists.summary: DJ Asterion. Sound engineer turned storyteller. Hypnotic grooves, soaring synths and moments that move the dancefloor.
bio: Every set is a new chapter.

artists.name: Dan Scot
artists.summary: Dan Scot is a psytrance DJ with a passion for music and community, known for energetic performances and a deep connection with his dancefloor.
bio: His music reflects his love for the genre, and for the last 18 years he has kept pushing the boundaries of what is possible with his sets.
Dan Scot takes his dancefloor on a journey through a dystopic wonderland.

artists.name: Firehorse
artists.summary: DJ Firehorse has been playing sacred world music for over 30 years.
bio: Her sets blend mantras and tribal music with a modern beat.

artists.name: JamDay
artists.summary: Signed to Sonic Tantra / Flying Woofer Records in Goa, JamDay has been contributing to the South African psy and festival tribe since the early 2000s.

artists.name: Midiclorian
artists.summary: Cape Town DJ Ryan Wallis brings a storyteller's instinct to the dancefloor, blending powerful melodies with driving rhythms.
bio: With over 23 years of music production experience and a background in sound engineering, Ryan has been making waves in the local scene over the last few years.

artists.name: SKAM
artists.summary: While deep tech and deep house laid the foundation, SKAM's true passion is exploring new sonic territories.
bio: His productions move through hip hop, techno, dubstep, drum & bass and future jungle. Synthesizers, raw dark basslines, intricate effects and polyrhythms keep listeners locked in and longing for more.
Notable appearances include RAMFEST, FRAT, Sizzled, SA Cocktail Week, Don't Mind The Bass and the Global Annual 420 Party.

artists.name: Thomas
artists.summary: Thomas is looking forward to playing at Earthdance and being there for the whole experience.
